title: East Africa Planting Calendar — Bimodal Rainfall Zones
content:
## East Africa Planting Calendars — Bimodal Rainfall Zones

Most of Kenya, Tanzania (highlands), and Uganda receive two rainy seasons per year.

### Long Rains Season (Masika)

**Rains arrive:** March (Coast/lowland) — April (Highlands)
**Plant:** 2–3 weeks after first good rains, when soil is moist 10cm deep
**Main crops:** Maize, beans, sorghum, vegetables
**Harvest:** July–September

| Crop | Plant date (highlands) | Plant date (lowland) | Harvest |
|------|----------------------|--------------------|---------|
| Maize (early) | 1–15 March | 15 Feb – 1 March | June–July |
| Maize (medium) | 15 March – 15 April | 1–15 March | July–August |
| Beans | 1 March – 15 April | 15 Feb – 1 March | May–June |
| Tomatoes (transplant) | 1–15 March | 15 Feb – 1 March | May–July |
| Kale/Sukuma | March–April | Feb–March | May onwards |

### Short Rains Season (Vuli)

**Rains arrive:** October (Coast) — November (Highlands)
**Plant:** October–November
**Main crops:** Maize, beans, vegetables
**Harvest:** January–March

| Crop | Plant date | Harvest |
|------|-----------|--------|
| Maize | Oct 15 – Nov 15 | Jan–Feb |
| Beans | Oct 15 – Nov 30 | Dec–Jan |
| Tomatoes | Oct 15 – Nov 15 | Jan–Mar |

### Special Notes by Zone

**Kenya Central (Kirinyaga, Nyeri, Murang'a):**
- March–May long rains; October–December short rains
- Coffee flowering: March–April; harvest: Oct–December
- Tea: year-round harvest; peak: April–June and October–December

**Kenya Rift Valley (Nakuru, Eldoret, Uasin Gishu):**
- March–May long rains (most reliable)
- Short rains erratic — do not rely for maize
- Wheat: plant June–July (cool season); harvest Nov–Dec

**Tanzania Northern (Arusha, Kilimanjaro, Moshi):**
- Long rains: March–May
- Short rains: November–January (Vuli)
- Coffee/banana year-round with irrigation
- Tomato: best transplant October for Nov–Jan harvest (short rains)

**Uganda (Kampala, Mbale, Mbarara):**
- First rains: March–May
- Second rains: August–November
- Maize planted in both seasons
- Banana: year-round production

### Key Rule: Plant Within 2 Weeks of First Good Rains

For rain-fed crops, delayed planting by 3+ weeks reduces yields 20–40%. The soil must have moisture 10–15cm deep before planting. Do not plant dry — germination will fail.

## Kalenda ya Upanzi Afrika Mashariki

### Masika (Mvua Ndefu)

Mvua inafika: Machi (pwani) — Aprili (milima)
Panda: wiki 2–3 baada ya mvua ya kwanza nzuri
Vizao: Mahindi, maharagwe, mboga
Vuvio: Julai–Septemba

### Vuli (Mvua Fupi)

Mvua inafika: Oktoba (pwani) — Novemba (milima)
Panda: Oktoba–Novemba
Vuvio: Januari–Machi

### Kanuni Muhimu

Panda ndani ya wiki 2 baada ya mvua ya kwanza nzuri. Kuchelewa wiki 3+ kunapunguza mavuno 20–40%.
